inputs.prompt:
AUDIO POLICY — applies to the entire video: Generate only synchronized mechanical Foley and quiet room ambience. No human voice, speech, dialogue, whisper, murmur, crowd noise, chant, singing, melody, soundtrack, background music, or non-diegetic music.

<Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, and <Picture 4> are four sequential storyboard keyframes for ONE continuous 15-second scene. They show the SAME anonymous LEGO producer throughout: identical black hair, beige torso, proportions, face style, material, and scale. Preserve the warm-orange miniature brick world, dark-brown wood and charcoal machinery, with cobalt-blue AI light as the only cool accent. Do not turn the references into a grid or split screen.

Generate one coherent 15-second video with four clearly staged beats and motivated match transitions:
0.0–3.75 s — Follow beside the same producer carrying a script box from the planning table toward the camera station, based on <Picture 1>. One main action. Stable subject geometry. Foley: footsteps and paper-box movement only.
3.75–7.50 s — The moving script box passes close to lens as a natural wipe, revealing the same producer screening film at the rough-cut desk, based on <Picture 2>. Slow half-orbit around the desk. Foley: film reel and desk mechanisms only.
7.50–11.25 s — A cobalt-blue indicator light creates a motivated match cut to the same producer checking four alerting workstations, based on <Picture 3>. Controlled lateral camera move; no extra people. Foley: short electronic beeps and switches only.
11.25–15.08 s — The camera rises smoothly into an overhead view of the same producer supervising the continuous workstation line toward the render exit, based on <Picture 4>. Foley: ventilation fan and conveyor mechanisms only.

Continuity constraints: one consistent producer identity, one consistent architectural world, same palette and lighting direction, stable object scale, stable spatial orientation, no duplicate people, no morphing body or machinery, no random props, no abrupt color shift, no uncontrolled camera shake. Transitions must be caused by an existing foreground object, shared movement direction, or the cobalt-blue indicator light.

Text constraints: Do not invent, redraw, translate, animate, or add any Chinese characters, subtitles, labels, logos, or watermarks. Existing tiny signs from the references should remain background texture, small and static, never receive a close-up, and never become the visual subject.
